newsitem.title: USA: May flows to US stock funds total $20.14 bln - ICI.
newsitem.headline: May flows to US stock funds total $20.14 bln - ICI.

text.p: Net flows to stock mutual funds totalled $20.14 billion in May, up from inflows of $15.71 billion in April, a trade group said Thursday.
That May total was also an increase from the Investment Company Institute's estimate of $18.5 billion in net stock fund flows for the month, made June 12.
For the first five months of 1997, the flow into stock funds totaled $93.18 billion, 24.6 percent behind the 1996 pace of $123.65 billion for the same period.
Net inflows to bond and income funds were $2.75 billion in May after net inflows of $759.9 million in April, ICI said.
Money market funds had an inflow of $10.26 billion in May, compared with an outflow of $22.33 billion in April.
ICI said much of the pickup in stock mutual fund inflows during May was in the aggressive growth and growth categories.
